name_zh: 血糖状态（正常/糖尿病前期/糖尿病）

overlap.rationale_zh: 与核心血糖领域为同一指标；原文校正项未核对到与核心项的对应，保守不超过 0.3

evidence.quote: Diabetes and prediabetes were significantly associated with increased risk of all-cause (diabetes: RR, 1.61 [95% CI 1.49, 1.73]; prediabetes: RR, 1.08 [95% CI 1.01, 1.15]), and cardiovascular disease (diabetes: RR, 1.59 [95% CI 1.41, 1.78]; prediabetes: RR, 1.10 [95% CI 1.00, 1.21]) mortality.
evidence.estimand_zh: 糖尿病、糖尿病前期相对血糖正常者的全因死亡率比（观测性 Cox 校正 RR）

alternatives_considered.estimate: 香港糖尿病登记，糖尿病前期年龄分层
alternatives_considered.why_not: 人群为就诊登记，非全人群，且无三水平全因 HR

alternatives_considered.estimate: 华东 10 年队列 IFG/糖尿病
